task_spec: CapacityLimiter.total_tokens must accept any infinite float (math.inf, float('inf')), not only the singleton math.inf object. Setting it to infinity outside an event loop must not raise TypeError. (agronholm/anyio#1189)

bugs.description: total_tokens setter uses identity `value is not math.inf` to allow infinity. Only the singleton math.inf passes; any other infinite float (float('inf'), 1e400, a computed inf) is not the same object, so `value is not math.inf` is True and it raises TypeError('must be an int or math.inf') for a legitimately infinite value. Correct is `not math.isinf(value)` (value comparison).
